reader.zh-Hant:
LMWrapper 是呼叫各供應商模型的統一入口；並行描述 OpenAI 相容後端與 Gemini 後端的差異設定鍵。

type.ChatMessage 描述對話訊息的結構化形狀（角色與內容），實際驗證發生在 _validate_messages() 一路。

閱讀時請同時對照各 wrapper 的 init 參數：openai-like 需要 base URL，gemini 路徑則關注金鑰與模型字串。
reader.en:
`LMWrapper` is the unified entrypoint for chat completions across providers, including OpenAI-compatible backends and Gemini.

`type.ChatMessage` documents the structured message shape (role + content); validation happens along `_validate_messages()`.

When reading symbols, cross-check `init` parameters: openai-like providers require a base URL; Gemini paths focus on keys and model ids.
reader.ja:
`LMWrapper` は複数プロバイダ向けの統一入口です（OpenAI 互換と Gemini など）。

`type.ChatMessage` はメッセージ構造（役割と本文）を表し、検証は `_validate_messages()` 側で行われます。

各ラッパーの `init` を読み比べてください：互換系は base URL、Gemini 系は鍵とモデル文字列が焦点になります。

types.name: ChatMessage
notes: System messages are accepted by validator; LMWrapper also supports separate system_prompt.

symbols.name: LMWrapper
symbols.summary: Unified entrypoint for chat completion across providers.

init.signature: LMWrapper(*, provider, model, api_key=None, lm_api_url=None, request_options=None)

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key passed directly to the selected backend.

params.name: lm_api_url
params.description: OpenAI-compatible base_url for providers local/openai/grok. Required for openai-like providers.

params.name: request_options
params.description: Optional provider request options. OpenAIWrapper forwards as kwargs; GeminiWrapper maps temperature/max_tokens. If omitted, LMWrapper uses an empty dict.

raises.when: provider in ['local','openai','grok'] and final lm_api_url is empty

methods.name: set_system_prompt
methods.summary: Set system prompt stored in LMWrapper.

params.name: system_prompt
params.description: System instruction passed to backend on each call.

logging.message: System prompt has been set in LMWrapper

methods.name: get_completion
methods.signature: get_completion(messages: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]
methods.summary: Validate messages and invoke backend chat, returning a normalized assistant payload.

params.name: messages
params.description: Each item must include role and content.

returns.description: Normalized assistant payload containing role, content, and optional tool_calls / gemini_content.

raises.when: messages is not list/tuple or item is not dict or content is not str

logging.message: System prompt has not been set. Continuing without it.

methods.name: analyze_image_bytes
methods.signature: analyze_image_bytes(*, prompt: str, image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str, system_prompt: Optional[str] = None) -> str
methods.summary: Single-turn vision: Gemini inlineData or OpenAI-compatible image_url data URLs.

params.name: system_prompt
params.description: Overrides instance system prompt when set.

symbols.name: OpenAIWrapper
symbols.summary: OpenAI-compatible chat backend using openai SDK.

methods.name: chat
methods.signature: chat(messages: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], system_prompt: Optional[str]=None, tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]
behavior: If system_prompt is provided, it is prepended as a system message.
When tools are provided, wraps them with ToolAdapter.to_openai_tool() and sets tool_choice='auto'.

returns.description: Assistant payload with role, content, and optional tool_calls.

error_handling.current: Catches all exceptions, logs exception, and raises LMBackendError.

symbols.name: GeminiWrapper
symbols.summary: Gemini backend using HTTP requests to generateContent endpoint.

methods.name: chat
methods.signature: chat(messages: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], system_prompt: Optional[str]=None, tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]

returns.description: Assistant payload with role, content, optional tool_calls, and gemini_content.

error_handling.current: Catches all exceptions, logs exception, and raises LMBackendError.
error_handling.planned: Add timeout + retry backoff (see docs/LMWrapper_手動修改建議_1_2.md).

symbols.name: gemini_to_openai_like
symbols.summary: Convert Gemini generateContent JSON into the assistant payload shape expected by AgentRuntime.

returns.description: Payload containing role, content, optional tool_calls, and gemini_content.

raises.when: Gemini response does not contain the expected candidates/content structure

exceptions.summary: Base runtime error for LM wrapper failures.
Raised when get_completion() is called before backend initialization.
Raised when message payloads fail shape or role validation.
Raised when provider-specific backend requests fail.

runtime_notes.content: This module uses logging.getLogger(__name__). Configure handlers/level in application entrypoint.
get_completion() returns a normalized assistant dict, not plain text. AgentRuntime relies on optional tool_calls and gemini_content fields for multi-step tool execution.
For local/openai/grok providers, pass lm_api_url explicitly. For Gemini, provide api_key and model; request_options controls temperature, max_tokens, and timeout.
